name: Algo-rythmique
description: Armand of the reputable Lepaute Horlogerie is responsible for managing the toy booth, allowing passersby to freely enjoy the "Toy Adventurers" in a quiet environment. Thus, guests may discover the unique charm and variety of complex ways to play the toys offer, as well as cultivate a deep interest in the stories of the adventurers on whom the toys were based on...
